remarks: This exquisite condo is nestled in one of Norwalk's most vibrant communities and picturesque scenery. Enjoy the perfect balance of urban convenience and natural beauty. Step into a spacious living area filled with abundant natural light, thanks to large windows & sliders that create a warm and inviting atmosphere with full water views. The generously sized rooms offer plenty of space for relaxation and entertainment, ensuring comfort for any lifestyle. The friendly and welcoming community adds to the appeal. Located in a prime spot, you'll have easy access to Norwalk's best dining, shopping, and entertainment options. Enjoy a walk on a 3 mile nature walk loop right outside your door along the water. Commuters will appreciate the proximity to major highways and public transportation, making travel a breeze.
